race.comment: HALO PHENOMENA (8) is the one to beat after coming back from Saturday company at Randwick in Highway grade, where he was beaten seven and a half lengths over 1400m after beginning awkwardly. His third at this track the run prior, beaten a long neck in a Class 3, reads much better for this. Fitter now with proven track-and-trip form. VIERVILLE (4) brings the strongest distance profile, with four wins from eight starts at 1200m, and the quick back-up plus drop from 60.5kg to 56kg are genuine positives, though he does have to lift off an even BM66 run at Scone. ARCTIC LEGEND (1) has the most compelling course-and-distance record, with three wins and one place from five tries, and his Open fourth over 900m on heavy ground looks a useful lead-in back to 1200m. HE'S MY WARRIOR (7) was plain at Moree last start after racing keenly, but his previous third at this track, beaten a long neck, keeps him in the mix as a place-to-win chance if he returns to that level.
